episodeTitle.en: Why companies are becoming a series of loops | Anish Acharya (a16z)
episodeTitle.zh: 为什么公司正在变成一连串的反馈循环？｜a16z 的 Anish Acharya

guestBioOfficial.zh: Anish Acharya 是 a16z 关注消费领域的普通合伙人。他创办过 SocialDeck 和 Snowball，两家公司分别被 Google 和 Credit Karma 收购。这段从创业、运营到投资的经历，也体现在他对分发和竞争优势的分析里。
guestBioOfficial.en: Anish is a general partner at a16z focused on consumer investing. Before investing, he founded SocialDeck and Snowball, acquired by Google and Credit Karma respectively. He approaches distribution as both an operator and an investor.

title.en: Why companies are becoming a series of loops | Anish Acharya (a16z)
title.zh: 为什么公司正在变成一连串的反馈循环？｜a16z 的 Anish Acharya

summary.zh: Anish 设想，公司里的个人、职能和业务部门各自运行反馈循环，有些结果最终会改变经营决策。对谈也追问：当模型能力扩散、平台不再轻易向创业者开放自己的关系网，新的优势可能从哪里积累？
summary.en: Anish imagines feedback loops operating at the level of a person, a function, and a business unit. He then considers which advantages endure as models spread and incumbent platforms guard access to their networks.

insights.title: 反馈最后要能改变经营决策
insights.detail: 局部任务的结果可以逐层传递，直至提醒 CEO 调整商业模式或线下业务。Anish 仍把人的判断放在这些循环之中。
insights.detailEn: Feedback from a task or function can reach the CEO and change how the business operates. Anish still sees people as essential to these loops.

insights.title: 借来的平台关系网未必能沉淀下来
insights.detail: 平台经营者已经很懂网络效应，也会防着别人借自家网络再建一个网络。Anish 因此重新看重用户主动带来的口碑。
insights.detailEn: Platforms know the value of their networks and defend them. Anish sees renewed importance in grassroots word of mouth.

insights.title: 用一个小项目校准对模型的直觉
insights.detail: 不必先找到值得成立公司的点子。找一个能反复接入新模型的小项目，亲自感受哪里变好了、哪里依然令人沮丧。
insights.detailEn: A small side project gives builders somewhere to try each new model and discover both its gains and its frustrations.
insights.titleEn: Build somewhere to test new models

related.reason: 从用户参与度出发，比较反馈循环与长期留存怎样相互作用。
related.reasonEn: How engagement and retention feed each other in consumer products.

title.en: The hierarchy of engagement | Sarah Tavel (Benchmark, Greylock, Pinterest)
title.zh: 参与度的层级 | 莎拉·塔维尔（Sarah Tavel，Benchmark、Greylock、Pinterest）
